name: gizza-ai/parse-query-string
summary: Parse a URL query string into structured key/value data

tool.description: Parse a URL query string into JSON: ordered key/value pairs (duplicates preserved) plus a structured object where repeated keys become arrays and bracket notation (a[]=, a[0]=, user[name]=) is expanded into nested arrays/objects. Percent-decodes keys/values; optionally decodes + to a space.
